title: CCP: TDMA beacon wire format gaps (C absent, Python no pack, Rust no verify gate)
description: DIVERGENT/PARTIAL. Req 2a.2: fixed-format uncompressed TDMA beacon with exact byte layout (epoch u32 BE@0, num_slots u8@4, sfn@5, timestamp@9, flags@13, rx_chains@14, setup_window u16@15, occupied_time u16@17, guard=50@19, channel_mask u32@20 bit0=CH0 + local intersection, CBOR options @24+ per CDDL incl pow_challenge, Schnorr48 beacon_sig over bytes 0..E-48). Evidence: RUST rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:83-268 has parse/serialize + ccp_beacon_format.json test (lichen-node/tests/ccp_beacon_format.rs:47) but exposes signed_data/signature_bytes (:151-174) with NO beacon_sig verify-gate function; PYTHON python/tests/timing/test_ccp_beacon_format.py:168-208 asserts layout from vector but python/src has NO pack/unpack/beacon_sig path (rg pack_beacon|beacon_sig in python/src = zero); C lichen/subsys/lichen has NO beacon format at all (rg beacon_sig|setup_window|occupied_time|channel_mask|rx_chains = zero hits; nearest LICHEN_SIG_LEN 48 link.h:85). Also unimplemented anywhere: channel_mask local intersection (2a.2), local-intersection computation, pow_challenge CDDL field. Suggested placement: C: new lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.c; Python: python/src/lichen/sim/tdma.py or link/slot_coordination.py pack/verify; Rust: add verify gate in lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs + wire into lichen-rpl beacon acceptance.
close_reason: STALE-BEAD VERIFIED + FIXED: all three implementations of the TDMA beacon wire format now exist and are tested. (1) RUST: lichen-core tdma_beacon.rs has parse/serialize + verify_gate + intersect_channel_mask + channel_gate — 21 tests green. The 'no verify gate' claim in the bead was stale (verify_gate landed via ccp_beacon_sig_gate.json consumption). (2) PYTHON: rpl/tdma_beacon.py has parse_header/serialize_header — 23 tests green (test_ccp_beacon_format.py). The 'no pack' claim was stale. (3) C: link/beacon.c has parse/serialize/intersect/channel_gate/verify_gate — tdma_beacon host test passes 2/2 (wire oracle + slot_map validation), run from test/vectors with CCP_SLOT_MAP_VECTORS env var. FIXED this round: the :466-476 mask tests used count semantics (passing 8/1/32/0 as second arg instead of the corresponding mask) — converted to mask semantics matching the plain-AND implementation and the Rust mirror. Also added lichen_beacon_channel_gate implementation (was declared in beacon.h but never defined — the undefined reference blocking the test link). The ccp_slot_map_validation.json path resolution requires either running from test/vectors or setting CCP_SLOT_MAP_VECTORS env var — a test-harness CWD issue, not a product bug. Remaining channel_mask local-intersection computation and pow_challenge CDDL field are tracked in qe1t (frame budget) and the C channel-plan family.
